JXPilot, a Java reimplementation of XPilot, a multiplayer gravity war game.
Copyright (C) 2026 Tony Kay and the JXPilot contributors.

Derived from XPilot 4.5.5, Copyright (C) 1991-2002 by Bjørn Stabell, Ken Ronny Schouten,
Bert Gijsbers and Dick Balaska. JXPilot is an independent derivative port: the original
XPilot authors were not involved in it and do not endorse it.

JXPilot is free software under the GNU General Public License, version 2 or (at your option)
any later version; see META-INF/LICENSE. Source code: https://github.com/awkay/jxpilot
(each release's source is attached to its GitHub release as a tag archive).

Bundled third-party components:
  - Fira Code font (SIL Open Font License 1.1): fonts/FiraCode-LICENSE.txt (client jar)
  - Liberation fonts 2.1.5, Red Hat (SIL Open Font License 1.1): fonts/Liberation-LICENSE.txt
    (client jar)
  - LWJGL 3 and its native libraries, including OpenAL Soft (GNU LGPL 2 or later):
    META-INF/licenses/lwjgl/ (client jar)
  - Sound effects by Juhani Junkala and Kenney (CC0 1.0): sounds/LICENSE-sounds.txt and
    sounds/CC0-1.0.txt (client jar)

OpenAL Soft source (GNU LGPL version 2 or later): the client jar contains OpenAL Soft libraries
(libopenal / OpenAL.dll) built by the LWJGL project from https://github.com/kcat/openal-soft at commit
90191edd20bb877c5cbddfdac7ec0fe49ad93727. That source is attached to every JXPilot GitHub release as
openal-soft-source-90191edd20bb877c5cbddfdac7ec0fe49ad93727.tar.gz. For at least three years after we
distribute a release, anyone may also ask for that source by opening an issue at
https://github.com/awkay/jxpilot; we will provide it for no more than the cost of providing it. You may
replace the bundled library with your own build of OpenAL Soft (LWJGL loads it from
-Dorg.lwjgl.openal.libname=PATH); the license text is in META-INF/licenses/lwjgl/openal_soft_license.txt.
